title: China-to-Kenya Air-source Heat Pump Compliance Gap Matrix
provenance: AI-compiled, multi-model cross-checked, not human-verified. Informational only; confirm with the official regulator and a qualified professional. Not legal/certification/customs/market-access advice.

rows.requirement: EPRA Energy Efficiency Label — Air Conditioners and Heat Pumps
rows.target_requirement: The Energy and Petroleum Regulatory Authority (EPRA) administers Kenya's energy efficiency labelling scheme for air conditioners and heat pumps. Regulated products must carry an EPRA-approved energy efficiency label disclosing the energy efficiency ratio (EER) or coefficient of performance (COP), annual energy consumption, and star rating. Labels must be affixed before sale in Kenya and must reflect performance tested at conditions applicable to the Kenyan grid (240 V, 50 Hz). Importers are responsible for registering products with EPRA and obtaining label authorisation.
target_standards: EPRA Energy Efficiency Labelling Regulations for Air Conditioners
KS 1957 (Kenya Standard for energy efficiency of air conditioners)
rows.china_equivalent: China's energy efficiency labelling for heat pumps and air conditioners is administered by the China Energy Label (CEL) scheme under GB 12021.3 (room air conditioners) and GB 25454 (heat pump water heaters). COP and SCOP performance is rated against Chinese test conditions at 220 V, 50 Hz. Chinese energy label ratings and test reports based on GB/T 7725 or GB 25454 are not accepted as equivalent to EPRA labelling, as test conditions, rating scale, and administrative requirements differ.
china_standards: GB 12021.3 (China energy efficiency label — room air conditioners)
GB 25454 (China — heat pump water heaters energy efficiency)
GB/T 7725 (China — room air conditioners test methods)
rows.gap: Chinese energy label ratings and test data are not accepted for EPRA labelling. Exporters must obtain EPRA label authorisation with test evidence conducted or accepted under Kenyan conditions (240 V, 50 Hz). The slight voltage difference (220 V CN vs 240 V KE) may affect rated performance values and must be addressed in test reports submitted to EPRA.

mandatory_status.target: Mandatory — EPRA energy efficiency label required before sale of regulated air conditioners and heat pumps in Kenya
mandatory_status.cn: Mandatory China Energy Label (CEL) for domestic Chinese market; not equivalent to EPRA label

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Significant gap — EPRA energy efficiency label authorisation is mandatory for sale in Kenya; Chinese CEL ratings and test data are not accepted; re-testing or test data review at 240 V / 50 Hz conditions required.

source.publisher: Energy and Petroleum Regulatory Authority (EPRA), Kenya

rows.requirement: EPRA Minimum Energy Performance Standards (MEPS) — Heat Pumps and Air Conditioners
rows.target_requirement: EPRA enforces Minimum Energy Performance Standards (MEPS) for air conditioners and heat pump products sold in Kenya under the Energy Act 2019. Products that do not meet the applicable MEPS EER or COP threshold may not legally be imported or sold in Kenya. MEPS thresholds are set by EPRA and may be updated periodically. Importers must confirm the current applicable MEPS threshold with EPRA before shipment, as below-threshold products cannot be cleared for sale even with a PVOC certificate.
target_standards: EPRA Minimum Energy Performance Standards for Air Conditioners
KS 1957 (Kenya Standard — energy efficiency of air conditioners)
rows.china_equivalent: China's MEPS for room air conditioners and heat pumps are set under GB 21455 (room air conditioners) and GB 29541 (heat pump water heaters). COP and SCOP thresholds are tested at Chinese standard conditions (220 V, 50 Hz, GB/T 7725 test method). Chinese MEPS compliance is assessed on Chinese test conditions and is not directly transferable to Kenyan EPRA MEPS thresholds, which are based on 240 V, 50 Hz conditions.
china_standards: GB 29541 (China MEPS — heat pump water heaters)
GB/T 7725 (China room air conditioner test methods)
rows.gap: Chinese MEPS compliance does not satisfy Kenyan EPRA MEPS requirements. Exporters must confirm current EPRA MEPS thresholds, verify product EER/COP performance at 240 V 50 Hz test conditions, and ensure the product meets the applicable Kenyan threshold before shipment. Below-MEPS products cannot be legally sold in Kenya regardless of PVOC status.

mandatory_status.target: Mandatory — products must meet EPRA MEPS threshold before import and sale in Kenya
mandatory_status.cn: Mandatory GB MEPS for domestic Chinese market; Chinese MEPS thresholds not equivalent to EPRA MEPS

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Significant gap — EPRA MEPS thresholds must be confirmed and met before import; Chinese MEPS ratings tested at 220 V conditions are not directly transferable; below-MEPS products cannot be legally imported or sold.

source.publisher: Energy and Petroleum Regulatory Authority (EPRA), Kenya

rows.requirement: KEBS Pre-Export Verification of Conformity (PVOC) — Mandatory Pre-Shipment Inspection
rows.target_requirement: The Kenya Bureau of Standards (KEBS) requires a mandatory Pre-Export Verification of Conformity (PVOC) for regulated products, including heat pumps and air conditioners, before shipment to Kenya. A KEBS-approved inspection body must inspect and test the goods at the origin country and issue a Certificate of Conformity (CoC). Goods arriving at Kenyan ports without a valid PVOC CoC will be detained, re-inspected at the importer's cost, or refused entry. The PVOC inspection verifies conformity to the applicable Kenya Standard (KS), including KS IEC 60335-2-40 for safety. The KEBS Diamond Mark of Quality may be required for locally marketed products. CCC certification from China is not recognised as equivalent to PVOC.
target_standards: KEBS PVOC Programme — Regulated Products List
KS IEC 60335-2-40 (Safety of heat pumps, air conditioners and dehumidifiers)
KEBS Diamond Mark of Quality scheme
rows.china_equivalent: China requires CCC (China Compulsory Certification) for heat pumps and air conditioners sold domestically, based on GB 4706.32 and GB 4343.1 for safety and EMC. CCC certificates issued by Chinese certification bodies cover only the domestic Chinese market and are not accepted as evidence of conformity for KEBS PVOC purposes.
rows.gap: CCC does not substitute KEBS PVOC. Chinese exporters must engage a KEBS-approved inspection body in China before shipment to obtain a Certificate of Conformity against the applicable KS standard. Failure to obtain PVOC is a critical compliance failure — goods will be detained at Nairobi port. Lead times for PVOC inspection must be factored into the export schedule.

mandatory_status.target: Mandatory — PVOC Certificate of Conformity required before shipment for regulated products including heat pumps and air conditioners
mandatory_status.cn: Mandatory CCC for domestic Chinese market; CCC not recognised by KEBS

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Critical pre-shipment gap — KEBS PVOC Certificate of Conformity is mandatory before export; CCC is not accepted; goods without valid PVOC will be detained at Nairobi port.

rows.requirement: NEMA ODS Refrigerant Controls — Phase-Down of R-22 and Import of HFC Refrigerants
rows.target_requirement: The National Environment Management Authority (NEMA) administers Kenya's obligations under the Montreal Protocol on Substances that Deplete the Ozone Layer (ODS). Kenya is phasing down R-22 (HCFC-22) in line with Article 5 developing-country commitments. Importers of heat pumps and air conditioners must hold a valid NEMA ODS import licence or permit for equipment containing HCFCs or HFCs. R-22 pre-charged equipment is subject to import restrictions and phase-down schedules. R-410A and R-32 refrigerants are permitted but may require NEMA notification or registration. Refrigerant type, charge quantity, and GWP information must be disclosed on unit labelling. NEMA may require an environmental impact assessment or ODS exemption for non-compliant refrigerant types.
target_standards: Montreal Protocol on Substances that Deplete the Ozone Layer — Article 5 commitments
Environmental Management and Co-ordination Act (EMCA), Kenya
rows.china_equivalent: China manages ODS under its Montreal Protocol obligations through the Ministry of Ecology and Environment. R-22 production and use is being phased down under China's HPMP. GB 9237 covers refrigerant safety classification. Chinese heat pumps and air conditioners exported with R-410A or R-32 comply with Chinese ODS phase-down direction but must separately comply with NEMA ODS import permit requirements for the Kenyan market. Chinese ODS documentation does not substitute NEMA permits.
china_standards: GB 9237 (China — refrigerating systems and heat pumps — safety and environmental requirements)
Ministry of Ecology and Environment ODS regulations
rows.gap: Chinese ODS compliance documentation does not substitute NEMA ODS import permits. Exporters must ensure the unit is not pre-charged with R-22 or other restricted HCFCs, confirm that the refrigerant type (R-410A or R-32 preferred) is permissible under current NEMA regulations, and verify that the Kenyan importer holds a valid NEMA ODS import licence before shipment. Refrigerant type and charge must be clearly labelled on the unit.

mandatory_status.target: Mandatory — NEMA ODS import licence required; R-22 pre-charged equipment subject to import restrictions; refrigerant labelling mandatory
mandatory_status.cn: Mandatory ODS controls under Chinese HPMP; GB 9237 refrigerant safety; R-22 phase-down ongoing; not equivalent to NEMA permit

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Significant gap — NEMA ODS import licence is mandatory; R-22 pre-charged units face import restrictions; Chinese ODS documents are not substitutes; exporters should use R-410A or R-32 and verify Kenyan importer holds a valid NEMA ODS permit.

rows.requirement: KS IEC 60335-2-40 Electrical Safety — Heat Pumps, Air Conditioners and Dehumidifiers
rows.target_requirement: KEBS has adopted KS IEC 60335-2-40 as the applicable Kenya Standard for the safety of electrically operated heat pumps, air conditioners, and dehumidifiers. This standard is aligned with IEC 60335-2-40 and covers electrical, mechanical, and thermal safety requirements for products intended for use at Kenya's grid voltage (240 V single-phase, 415 V three-phase, 50 Hz). Compliance with KS IEC 60335-2-40 is assessed as part of the KEBS PVOC pre-shipment inspection process. Test reports and technical documentation must demonstrate conformity at 240 V / 50 Hz. Exporters should note that the Kenyan supply voltage (240 V) is higher than the standard Chinese domestic supply (220 V), which may affect component ratings, insulation class, and thermal cutout settings.
target_standards: KS IEC 60335-2-40 (Kenya Standard — Safety of heat pumps, air conditioners and dehumidifiers)
rows.china_equivalent: China's mandatory safety standard for heat pumps and household air conditioners is GB 4706.32, which is harmonised with IEC 60335-2-40 but tested at Chinese grid conditions (220 V, 50 Hz). CCC certification requires factory audit and type testing to GB 4706.32 by a CNCA-designated certification body. While GB 4706.32 and KS IEC 60335-2-40 share the same IEC parent standard, CCC certification and GB 4706.32 test reports at 220 V are not accepted as KEBS PVOC conformity evidence at 240 V, and component ratings must be verified for the higher Kenyan voltage.
china_standards: GB 4706.32 (China mandatory safety standard — heat pumps, air conditioners and dehumidifiers)
GB 9237 (China — refrigerating systems and heat pumps safety)
rows.gap: CCC and GB 4706.32 test reports at 220 V do not satisfy KEBS PVOC conformity requirements at 240 V. Exporters must provide test evidence to KS IEC 60335-2-40 at 240 V / 50 Hz to the KEBS-approved inspection body. Component ratings (capacitors, motors, insulation, thermal cutouts) must be verified for 240 V operation. The 50 Hz frequency is the same in both markets, which reduces frequency-related re-testing scope, but voltage differences require explicit addressing in the technical file.

mandatory_status.target: Mandatory — KS IEC 60335-2-40 conformity assessed as part of KEBS PVOC pre-shipment inspection
mandatory_status.cn: Mandatory GB 4706.32 under CCC for domestic Chinese market; not equivalent to KS IEC 60335-2-40 PVOC evidence

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Significant gap — KS IEC 60335-2-40 conformity at 240 V / 50 Hz is required for KEBS PVOC; CCC and GB 4706.32 evidence at 220 V is not accepted; component ratings for 240 V operation must be verified and documented in the technical file submitted to the KEBS-approved inspection body.
